claim: Sample data stays in this browser and is cleared when demo mode ends.
where: landing facts, demo banner, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; change sample state, navigate to Privacy, assert demo storage is gone, re-enter a fresh sample, and assert requests are same-origin

claim: Exports the review packet as JSON.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; trigger export and assert a JSON review-packet download

claim: Real review packets are visible only to their signed-in team.
where: real packet sign-in panel and README
sandbox: two seeded team sessions; assert the other team receives 404 for read and approval, then assert the owning team can approve and creates an audit record

claim: Only the named owner can approve after every saved check and server-recorded test command and result.
where: review packet approval status and README
sandbox: seeded same-team owner and reviewer sessions; reject a client-forged done flag and wrong owner, save command/result evidence, approve as owner, and assert the server-recorded audit

claim: Only the Sociobot Entra tenant is accepted, and GitHub installations are mapped per team.
where: landing facts, real-work panel, README, and privacy page
sandbox: configured Sociobot and non-Sociobot authorities plus two team ids; reject every other authority and assert only the mapped team resolves to its GitHub App installation

claim: GitHub imports read every changed-file page and evaluate repository policy paths.
where: landing facts, how-it-works section, privacy page, and README
sandbox: local two-page GitHub fixture with 102 changed paths; assert page two is read and configured schema and infrastructure policy paths are both evaluated

claim: Each team sets its own repository-sensitive paths and required owners.
where: signed-in repository policy settings and pull-request import
sandbox: two seeded teams; save Acme/Service schema policy for one team, assert the other team cannot read it, and assert exact path matching

claim: Teams can set packet retention and delete a packet with its audit history.
where: team settings, packet controls, privacy page, and README
sandbox: seed an authenticated team with old and current packets; set 30-day retention and assert old packet/audit deletion, then explicitly delete the current packet and audit

claim: Packet audit history is visible only to its team, and duplicate approval reports a conflict.
sandbox: send two simultaneous valid owner approvals; assert one success and one conflict, then assert another team cannot read the audit history

claim: A signed-in reviewer can view and export a packet's audit history.
where: packet audit history, export control, and README
sandbox: mock an authenticated same-team packet API; open saved history, export JSON, and assert the audit entry is included

claim: The sample demo has no analytics or third-party runtime scripts.
sandbox: fresh browser context; record every request during landing, sample launch, evidence change, and export; assert every origin is the product origin

claim: Plans cost $12 per developer monthly or $99 per team monthly and use Sociobot checkout.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert both prices and the Sociobot checkout URL, restore a fixture license, and assert the verify request is used
